basic_details.organization_name: Andaman and Nicobar Islands Integrated Development Corporation (ANIIDCO)

application_fee.all_fee: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

qualification.education_qualification: MBA/Graduate in Engineering, Urban Planning or equivalent with at least 8 years experience in large infrastructure projects, project coordination, contract management, and stakeholder engagement.
qualification.details: Consultant (Project Coordination): MBA/Graduate in Engineering, Urban Planning or equivalent with at least 8 years experience in large infrastructure projects, project coordination, contract management, and stakeholder engagement. Consultant (Engineering & Contracts): Civil Engineer with at least 8 years experience in infrastructure projects, procurement, EPC contracts, project scheduling and monitoring. Consultant (Land Acquisition & Revenue Specialist): Graduate/Post Graduate in Engineering, Law or equivalent with at least 8 years experience in land acquisition, revenue matters, rehabilitation and resettlement, Government procedures. Consultant (Project Monitoring & MIS Specialist): Graduate in Engineering/MBA or equivalent with at least 8 years experience in project monitoring, MIS, data analytics, GIS, and dashboard development.

selection_process: Walk-in Interview (in-person or through Google Meet/VC)
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ANIIDCO Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://andamannicobar.gov.in, https://aniidco.and.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ANIIDCO Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://andamannicobar.gov.in, https://aniidco.and.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ANIIDCO Consultant positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the ANIIDCO Consultant positions is 12th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the Consultant positions at ANIIDCO ranges from ₹1,60,000 to ₹2,90,000 per month, depending on the specific role and experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Consultant positions is 50 years. There is no mention of age relaxation for any category in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the ANIIDCO Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by post to the General Manager (Perl.), ANIIDCO Ltd, Vikas Bhawan, Sri Vijaya Puram - 744101, or via email to [email protected] before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Consultant roles?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview, which can be attended in person or through Google Meet/VC. Candidates are also required to fill out a Google Form.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any specific educational qualifications required for the Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Yes, qualifications vary by post. For example, Project Coordination requires an MBA/Graduate in Engineering or Urban Planning, while Engineering & Contracts requires a Civil Engineer.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these Consultant positions is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 17th August 2026. Candidates can attend in person or virtually via Google Meet/VC.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: The total number of vacancies is listed as 0 in the provided data. However, the recruitment is for Consultant positions, and specific numbers might be detailed in the full notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for ANIIDCO?
faq.answer: The official websites for ANIIDCO are https://andamannicobar.gov.in and https://aniidco.and.nic.in. These sites can be used to download the application form and find more information.
